subject.title: fix(exec-approval): distinguish non-persistable command from ask=always policy in approval prompt

question: Should maintainers keep repairing this focused PR as the canonical fix for https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/97069, or promote a broader sibling PR instead?
rationale: Multiple open candidate PRs target the same user-visible approval prompt bug, and this branch still has code blockers plus a contributor proof gap, so the canonical landing path needs maintainer coordination.

options.title: Repair this PR before merge
options.body: Keep this PR open only if the author or maintainer fixes the parser, native/sibling renderer coverage, and real prompt proof before treating it as canonical.

options.title: Promote a broader sibling
options.body: If a sibling branch has cleaner renderer coverage and proof, preserve this PR's useful context there and close this PR only after the canonical fix is selected or merged.

recommendation.title: Repair this PR before merge
recommendation.body: Keep this PR open only if the author or maintainer fixes the parser, native/sibling renderer coverage, and real prompt proof before treating it as canonical.
